meaning_by_symbol.RF: random face flicker and broken hum
meaning_by_symbol.AP: opposite-face strict pulse and 2-tone and edge flash
meaning_by_symbol.A: tone all 6 faces for the duration at the intensity, start with the named face, let it fade
meaning_by_symbol.B: bell opposite faces alternating, pause equals the duration, 5 cycles
meaning_by_symbol.C: cloth over 2 adjacent edges near the named face for the duration at the intensity, then bell 3 times near the named face
meaning_by_symbol.D: warm each corner of the named face for the duration at the intensity, then trace each edge of that face
meaning_by_symbol.E: warm stone beside the named face for the duration at the intensity; rotate and repeat for each face
meaning_by_symbol.F: cool cloth over the whole Veyru for the duration; then fan the named face and the opposite face for the duration at the intensity
meaning_by_symbol.G: lamp the named face dim and the opposite face bright for the duration at the intensity
meaning_by_symbol.H: folded cloth on the named face for the duration at the intensity; bell each edge of that face 2 times
meaning_by_symbol.I: for each corner of the named face: brief bell at the intensity, then warm the 2 meeting edges for the duration
meaning_by_symbol.J: flat board against the named face for the duration at the intensity; rotate through face-pairs
meaning_by_symbol.K: bell the center of each face once starting with the named face, then warm stone beside Veyru for the duration
meaning_by_symbol.L: soft surface, named face up, rest for the duration at the intensity
meaning_by_symbol.M: cool cloth over the whole Veyru for the duration; then fan all 6 faces for the duration starting with the named face at the intensity
meaning_by_symbol.N: rotate slowly over the duration while keeping a steady tone near opposite faces starting with the named face at the intensity; then bell each corner once
meaning_by_symbol.DR: sliding or drifting light and blurred edges and wavering hum
meaning_by_symbol.ES: too bright and layered hum and frozen face pattern
meaning_by_symbol.LK: dim corners and fading edges and perimeter loss
meaning_by_symbol.HI: blazing white and harsh buzz and hot
meaning_by_symbol.RC: one face much brighter and whine
meaning_by_symbol.BS: wobble or flex edges or bulge and muffled hum
meaning_by_symbol.CV: dark center and hollow thin hum
meaning_by_symbol.top: the actual upper face, as seen, unless otherwise stated

reply.rationale: No defensible compositional paradigm survives the evidence test. Although many symbols are single letters and some others are two-letter strings, there are no minimal-pair frames showing the same slot with alternating fillers and stable meaning contributions. In particular, A–N behave like opaque procedure labels, not productive morphemes reused inside longer codes: e.g. LI, CD, DR, etc. do not have meanings predictable from L+I, C+D, D+R, and so on. The repeated use of letters and letter position is therefore insufficient evidence for segmentation. The standalone symbols top and bottom are also lexical items here, since no multi-morpheme constructions employ them. To avoid false morphology, the whole codebook is analyzed as a flat lexicon.
